cards.art: elderly cat with enormous drooping nose eavesdropping on cards
cards.lore: As the body fails, the sensors expand. You will hear every insult whispered by the youth.
cards.name: The Proboscis of Doom
cards.power: Eavesdrop: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Groan loudly at what you see.

cards.art: dog and cat mid-teeth-swap chaos mid-run
cards.lore: The indignity isn't losing your teeth; it's accidentally wearing your enemy's smile.
cards.name: The Chatter-Chompers
cards.power: Swap Equipment: Steal an item from a player. Give them "Gingivitis" in return.

cards.art: two elderly figures on scooters triggering mushroom cloud
cards.lore: If you do not complete the mission, you age instantly. The diaper remains constant.
cards.name: The Wrinkle-Storm
cards.power: Collision: Destroy 1 Future Timeline card. Both players cry.

cards.art: badger wedged in red pipe surrounded by cascading posterior hair
cards.lore: A diet of fast food leads to a legacy of posterior facial hair.
cards.name: The Foliage of Shame
cards.power: Clog: Block a pathway. No one moves until you are surgically removed.

cards.art: mole in thick goggles squinting at illegible document
cards.lore: The future is bright. Too bad you can't see it.
cards.name: The Squint-of Goggles
cards.power: Misread: Interpret a Rule Card incorrectly on purpose. Opponents must prove you wrong.

cards.art: rotund raccoon in birthday dress expanding outward at table
cards.lore: Push people away, and you grow old alone. And by alone, we mean "wide".
cards.name: The Phantom Waistline
cards.power: Space Hog: Occupy two zones at once. Push others into the Void.

cards.art: eagle with live squirrel on head failing to look inconspicuous
cards.lore: Graceful aging is a myth sold by hat salesmen.
cards.name: The Toupee of Denial
cards.power: Camouflage: Fail a stealth check. Everyone knows it's a squirrel.

cards.art: stork with creaking hinge-knees in windswept field, CREAK sound effects
cards.lore: The mind wants to tango. The cartilage wants to crumble.
cards.name: The Creaky-Knees Caliper
cards.power: Rust: -5 to Agility. You can now predict rain with your joints.

cards.art: two elderly possums screaming from bunk beds into eternity
cards.lore: Seventy years later, we still haven't decided who gets the top bunk.
cards.name: The Bicker-of Bunker
cards.power: Stalemate: Skip your turn to ensure your opponent also skips theirs.

cards.art: glowing cookie surrounded by green lightning vortex in void
cards.lore: The war didn't start over land or ideology. It started over a snickerdoodle.
cards.name: The Cookie of Causality
cards.power: Inciting Incident: Restart the game from Turn 1. Keep all damage.

cards.art: aardvark and rabbit arguing over Ranch bottle across barbed-wire table
cards.lore: Robots may inherit the earth, but they will still have to listen to us argue about condiments.
cards.name: The Salad Dressing Divider
cards.power: Petty Theft: Steal one resource. Claim it was yours for 40 years.

cards.art: furry hand clutching disintegrating letter near gravestone with flower
cards.lore: He died hating you. You win the argument, but lose the soul.
cards.name: The Unsent Apology
cards.power: Regret: Take 10 Psychic Damage. Heal an opponent 10 HP.

cards.art: decaying squid holding UNFAIR sign next to SpongeBob in cobweb
cards.lore: We will dismantle the establishment, even if we are decomposing while doing it.
cards.name: The Strike-Forever of Sign
cards.power: Filibuster: Talk uninterrupted for 60 seconds. If you stop, you lose.

cards.art: bear and rabbit in wheelchairs jousting with IV poles mid-spark
cards.lore: Joust: Roll a d6. On a 1, you have a heart attack. On a 6, opponent dies.
cards.name: The Wheelchair Joust
cards.power: Chivalry isn't dead, it's just on life support and very angry.

cards.art: two elderly men tangled in massive tree, football lodged in beard knot
cards.lore: Hope is for people who aren't stuck in a tree for 70 years with Harold.
cards.name: The Grudge-Tree
cards.power: Entanglement: Bind yourself to another player. If you fall, they fall.

cards.art: ouroboros snake biting itself amid cursing symbols and flame
cards.lore: It's your fault. No, it's my fault. No, it's your fault for making it my fault.
cards.name: The Loop of Blame
cards.power: Recursion: Replay the last turn exactly as it happened. Blame the dice.

cards.art: skeleton waiter in cobwebbed chair holding deli number ticket
cards.lore: Madame Foster is just finishing up. She's been in the craft aisle for three decades.
cards.name: The Skeleton of Waiter
cards.power: Hold Music: Force an opponent to hum a tune while you think. If they stop, they skip a turn.

cards.art: tiny figure in striped tube slide descending into black void
cards.lore: The ride ends when you die. Please keep arms and legs inside the existential dread.
cards.name: The Slide of Eternity
cards.power: Gravity Trap: You cannot leave this card until you roll a double.

cards.art: bespectacled aardvark at buzzer podium in full panic
cards.lore: If you win, you have to keep playing. The only winning move is to be wrong.
cards.name: The Unanswered Riddle
cards.power: Analysis Paralysis: Force a player to answer a trivia question. If they hesitate, they freeze.

cards.art: screaming yellow blob holding sock to ear against brick wall
cards.lore: I made a brother! He smells like feet and listens to my screams.
cards.name: The Sock-Phone
cards.power: Nonsense Call: Shout a random phrase. Any player who laughs takes damage.

cards.art: elderly rabbit hunched at child's desk surrounded by flying pink pigs
cards.lore: There is always next year. And the year after that. Mr. Ratburn is immortal.
cards.name: The 40th Grade of Desk
cards.power: Held Back: Negate a 'Level Up' card. You must repeat the tutorial.

cards.art: gravestone reading HE WAS CAREFUL amid lightning and scattered skulls
cards.lore: He never took a risk. His heart beat perfectly until the moment it died of boredom.
cards.name: The Safe Path of Grave
cards.power: Caution: Skip your turn to gain +1 Defense. Bore your opponents to death.

cards.art: vine-smothered typewriter with Chapter 1. half-typed in dusty light
cards.lore: Art is 1% inspiration and 99% staring at a wall until you die.
cards.name: The Unfinished Script
cards.power: Procrastination: Push any negative effect to the next turn. Repeat indefinitely.

cards.art: lonely funeral urn on cobwebbed shelf where a trophy should be
cards.lore: You showed up. That was the extent of your contribution to history.
cards.name: The Participation Trophy
cards.power: Validation: Gain 1 point for doing absolutely nothing.

cards.art: silver robot handing pink FIRED slip to crying dog construction worker
cards.lore: The future is efficient. You are not. Please vacate the premises.
cards.name: The Pink Slip Robot
cards.power: Automation: Replace your hand with a random algorithm (roll dice for actions).

cards.art: gruff pig in tweed jacket wielding laser cane firing into empty dirt
cards.lore: In the year 2000, the hunt doesn't require aim, just batteries.
cards.name: The Laser Cane
cards.power: Tech Upgrade: +5 Attack, but you forget who you are attacking.

cards.art: ripped squirrel vs. old man struggling with giant tractor tire
cards.lore: The weak shall inherit the gym, and the gym teacher shall inherit the hernia.
cards.name: The Gym Teacher's Hell
cards.power: Payback: Reflect all damage taken in the early game back to the dealer.

cards.art: glowing levitating diaper beside stoic duck retiree in bathrobe
cards.name: The Hover-Diaper
cards.power: Levitation: Immune to Ground attacks. Vulnerable to Dignity attacks. Science conquered gravity solely to deal with incontinence.

cards.art: troll king enthroned on garbage heap with rat court and fish-bone crown
cards.lore: When the nanny throws you out, you become King of the Dump.
cards.name: The Garbage Kingdom
cards.power: Scavenge: Draw cards from the discard pile. They smell bad.

cards.art: monkey alone at centennial party table with dental wire as only guest
cards.lore: Happy 100th Birthday. Your only friend is a piece of dental wire.
cards.name: The Retainer Party
cards.power: Isolation: You cannot be targeted by others. You also cannot win.

cards.art: grey concrete residential block descending into abyss void
cards.lore: A nice place where the soup is warm and the doors are locked from the outside.
cards.name: The Abyss Home
cards.power: Institutionalize: Remove a character from play. They are 'safe' now.

cards.art: rocking chair floating through starfield with trailing rope in silence
cards.lore: Rocking back and forth is the only propulsion left.
cards.name: The Zero-G Rocker
cards.power: Drift: Move in a random direction every turn. Ignore physics.

cards.art: holy sheep at podium pointing GO AWAY at mouse with bouncy ball
cards.name: The Pearly Gatekeeper
cards.power: Judgment: Reveal your hand. If you have any "Stolen Items", lose the game.

cards.art: wolf couple dancing as blue ghosts in cobwebbed Victorian drawing room by clock
cards.lore: The music stopped forty years ago, but the feet keep moving.
cards.name: The Empty Dance Floor
cards.power: Nostalgia: Skip your turn to relive a better turn from the past.

cards.art: sleeping figure under rubble of exploded dream cloud and debris
cards.lore: It was all a dream. A terrible, wrinkly, arthritis-filled dream.
cards.name: The Dream-Bubble Pop
cards.power: Wake Up: Cancel all active "Future" effects. Return to reality.

cards.art: enormous red DO NOT TOUCH button hanging from storm clouds on rope
cards.lore: When the plot gets too depressing, complain to the writers until they drop an anvil.
cards.name: The Reset Button
cards.power: Meta-Strike: Drop a 16-ton weight on the Game Master.

cards.art: knight helmet with yellow smiley face visor in soft diffused light
cards.lore: The ultimate defense against reality.
cards.name: The Denial Visor
cards.power: Effect: Block all 'Future' cards. If you can't see it, it isn't happening.

cards.art: anchor embedded in earth, heavy chains wrapped around bear paw
cards.lore: Why move forward when you can stay here and be angry?
cards.name: The Grudge Anchor
cards.power: Effect: Prevents a character from moving, changing, or growing as a person.

cards.art: ZZZZZT-engraved wooden hammer mid-swing with star bursts and sparks
cards.lore: For when the young people are being too loud.
cards.name: The Nap-Time Hammer
cards.power: Effect: Force a 'Dream Sequence' turn skip on any player acting too energetic.

cards.art: red brick crashing through card frame amid exploding glass shards
cards.lore: Escape the medium.
cards.name: The 4th Wall Brick
cards.power: Effect: Allows player to rewrite the text of one card with a marker.

cards.art: crumbling ornate fountain oozing purple liquid in empty garden
cards.lore: Drink deep and feel your bones liquefy.
cards.name: The Fountain of Old
cards.power: Field Effect: All movement speed is halved. Bathroom breaks double.

cards.art: suburban sidewalk with labeled CRINGE mines exploding along path
cards.lore: Watch your step. That's where you called your teacher 'Mom'.
cards.name: The Memory Lane Minefield
cards.power: Field Effect: Every step deals Psychic Damage based on past embarrassments.

cards.art: cracked window revealing tropical paradise from dim squalid room
cards.lore: Look at the life you could have had. Now look at your hand. Cry.
cards.name: The What-If Window
cards.power: Field Effect: Looking through it causes 'Depression' status.

cards.art: empty playground swingset in swirling vortex above spiral sandbox
cards.lore: Fun for the whole family, assuming the family hasn't been erased from existence.
cards.name: The Paradox Playground
cards.power: Field Effect: Time flows in reverse. Winners become Losers.

cards.art: robot-cat hybrid with smiley face and RGB glitch aura
cards.lore: It hurts to exist.
cards.name: The Glitch-Beast
cards.power: Chaos: Shuffle all discard piles into a new deck. Draw 5.

cards.art: giant pink eraser destroying card paper in close-up hand
cards.lore: The only permanent cure for aging.
cards.name: The Eraser
cards.power: Delete: Physically tear up one card from an opponent's hand.

cards.art: IOU ONE FUTURE note pinned to corkboard with red pushpin
cards.lore: Value is subjective.
cards.name: The Blank Cheque
cards.power: Bluff: Pretend you have a winning card. If no one calls you out, you win.

cards.art: FrizzleBob rabbit walking away waving BYE with ghost blob trailing behind
cards.lore: Game Over. You're still old. Go home.
cards.name: Uncle FrizzleBob's Exit
cards.power: Resign: Flip the table. Go outside. Play outside.

title: Fractal Future Fantasy: The Wrinkle-Rumble Starter Kit
